item.title: Automate Stable Processes, Not Confusion
item.description: Automation amplifies whatever process it inherits. If the underlying logic is unclear, automation can make disorder faster and harder to see.

item.title: Prototype Before Proposal
item.description: A working future-state prototype changes the sales conversation from promises about capability to evidence of capability.

item.title: Automation Debt
item.description: Every automated workflow creates maintenance, exceptions, and hidden assumptions. The gain is real only if somebody can still understand the map.

item.title: The Interface Is Not the Infrastructure
item.description: A website is the visible layer. The business system underneath determines whether attention turns into action, follow-up, and revenue.

item.title: The Verification Tax
item.description: AI makes production cheap. Mistakes stay expensive. As generation accelerates, verification becomes the bottleneck.

item.title: What a website conversion audit actually looks for
item.description: A practical diagnostic lens for homepage clarity, CTA friction, trust, and conversion leaks.
